name: StockBeacon – Product Waitlists for WooCommerce
author: wpvoid

sections.description:
StockBeacon – Product Waitlists for WooCommerce helps you capture demand on out-of-stock products and notify subscribers when items are available again.

Free

  • Product and per-variation waitlists for out-of-stock WooCommerce products, with separate subscriber lists for each variation
  • Secure form submissions with sanitization, and spam throttling
  • Automatic restock detection with background notification email batches
  • Duplicate prevention so the same customer is not added twice for the same product
  • Activity log for recent waitlist events
  • CSV export with product, status, and date filters
  • Mobile responsive design for the customer-facing notify form
  • Form styling and live preview for copy, colors, typography, and light or dark mode
  • Restock email editor and live preview for subject, content, button text, colors, and typography

Pro

  • ⭐ Double opt-in flow and confirmation support
  • ⭐ Advanced Analytics with conversion tracking, product breakdowns, and restock demand reports
  • ⭐ Shortcode and block support for placing waitlist forms where you need them
  • ⭐ Advanced form editor, custom CSS, redirects, and device previews
  • ⭐ Advanced email editor and confirmation-email design
  • ⭐ Provider sync with Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, and more
  • ⭐ Low-stock waitlists to capture demand before products fully sell out
  • ⭐ Restock reminders for customers who were notified but have not purchased yet
  • ⭐ Webhook notifications for signup and restock email events
  • ⭐ Cleanup controls for purging older waitlist records in batches

Privacy

The store owner is responsible for providing an appropriate privacy notice, selecting a lawful retention period, and configuring the optional consent checkbox where required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install StockBeacon – Product Waitlists for WooCommerce from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed, active, and meets the minimum version (see FAQ).
  4. Open WooCommerce → Waitlist to review settings and subscriber data.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. This plugin runs only when WooCommerce is active. If WooCommerce is missing, the plugin shows an admin notice and does not initialize.

Which versions do I need?

StockBeacon requires WordPress 6.0+, PHP 8.0+, and WooCommerce 8.0+.

Do customers get emailed automatically when I restock?

Yes. When a tracked waitlist item changes back to in stock, the plugin schedules background notification batches automatically. Pro adds delivery timing controls and restock reminders.

Where do I manage waitlist subscribers?

Use WooCommerce → Waitlist in wp-admin to review subscribers, filter waitlists, view activity, export CSV files, and run debug checks. You also get waitlist visibility in the WooCommerce product list and in each product’s Waitlist product-data tab.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. StockBeacon creates separate per-variation waitlists, so each size, color, or style can collect its own subscribers and trigger its own restock notifications.

Is there a shortcode or block?

Shortcode and block support are Pro features. In free, the notify form is shown automatically on eligible out-of-stock product pages.

Can I customize the notify form?

Yes. The plugin includes the default responsive form and lets developers override the template with stockbeacon-product-waitlists-for-woocommerce/form-out-of-stock.php in the active theme. Pro adds the visual form editor, presets, colors, layout controls, and live preview.

How do I export subscriber data?

Open WooCommerce → Waitlist, optionally choose product/status/date filters, and click Download CSV.
